episodes.title: 'THAT'S A CULT': Adam Mockler EXPOSES MAGA's Biggest Contradiction in Live Debate
episodes.description:
Adam Mockler debated Vashon — the Chicago Conservative — about whether MAGA is a cult.
Mockler had one devastating argument. Every single person who left the MAGA movement — Marjorie Taylor Green, Lauren Boebert, Thomas Massie, Tucker Carlson, Candace Owens — only left after serious threats or political extermination. And the one principle they wouldn't cross? Trump's involvement with those famous files.

That's not a political party. That's a cult.

I have thoughts — including why I don't think MAGA Republicans were ever actually anti-war. They went along with it because Trump said it. The moment he started the Iran war they fell right in line.

Let's get into it together.

🔔 Subscribe for daily reaction and commentary on the biggest moments in politics.
👍 Let me know in the comments — is MAGA a cult? And who do you think won this debate — Adam Mockler or the Chicago Conservative?

episodes.title: Francesca Fiorentini Takes Down MAGA Cultist Tulsi Gabbard!
episodes.description:

On Francesca Fiorentini's show, The Bitchuation Room, they broke down how this may affect Tulsi's involvement with Donald Trump's cabinet. Could there be a tug of war behind the cult leader that Tulsi Gabbard grew up with and the biggest cult leader in the world - the head of the cult of MAGA?

This is a must-see video to see this case made. Francesca Fiorentini is sure to continue to cover the wackiness of figures like Tulsi Gabbard and all the other kooks involved with MAGA.
